stories.title: Twee jonge debutanten, een weergaloze goal en een dominante tweede helft: Xavi kan verder bouwen aan Oranje na vermakelijke 1-1 tegen Duitsland

en.title: Two young debutants, a stunning goal and a dominant second half: Xavi can continue building Orange after entertaining 1-1 draw against Germany
en.summary: New coach Xavi's tactical intentions were evident in the Netherlands' match against Germany, with debutants Ruben van Bommel and Mexx Meerdink providing glimpses of a younger generation's potential.

stories.title: Na halve spijtbetuigingen buigt minister Van Weel uiteindelijk diep genoeg voor de Tweede Kamer: ‘Het was echt op het randje’

en.title: After partial apologies, Minister Van Weel ultimately apologizes sufficiently to Parliament: 'It was really on the edge'
en.summary: During a lengthy emergency debate on unprocessed crime reports, Justice Minister David van Weel faced opposition criticism for offering procedural apologies, though Parliament ultimately rejected a motion of no confidence against him.

stories.title: Oranje en debuterende Xavi spelen gelijk tegen Duitsland na prachtgoal Gakpo

en.title: Orange and debutant Xavi draw with Germany after magnificent goal by Gakpo
en.summary: The Dutch national team drew 1-1 with Germany in its first match under new coach Xavi Hernández, with Cody Gakpo scoring a spectacular equalizer in the final phase despite an impressive overall performance.

stories.title: Van Weel nog dieper door het stof, 'heb Tweede Kamer op verkeerde been gezet'

en.title: Van Weel goes further into the dust, 'I misled Parliament'
en.summary: After pressure from the opposition, Justice and Security Minister Van Weel acknowledged that he had misled Parliament regarding unprocessed citizen complaints to police, admitting his previous communications were incomplete.

stories.title: Kinderboekenschrijver Sjoerd Kuyper ontving kort voor zijn dood de Gouden Griffel

en.title: Children's author Sjoerd Kuyper received the Golden Griffel shortly before his death
en.summary: Children's author Sjoerd Kuyper won the 2026 Golden Griffel award for his book before dying at age 74 two days after receiving the prize with family present.

stories.title: Witte Huis laat verslaggevers weer toe van CNN, MS Now en Politico, na een gerechtelijk bevel hiertoe urenlang te hebben genegeerd

en.title: White House allows reporters from CNN, MS Now and Politico back after ignoring court order for hours
en.summary: The White House granted access to journalists from CNN, MS Now and Politico after a court order, which it had initially disregarded for several hours.

stories.title: Gouden Griffel 2026 voor overleden schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper

en.title: Golden Griffel 2026 awarded to deceased writer Sjoerd Kuyper
en.summary: Sjoerd Kuyper, who died Tuesday at age 74, won the 2026 Golden Griffel award for his book Maantje verhuist de zee. He received the prize before his death in the presence of his wife and publisher.

stories.title: Gouden Griffel voor ‘Maantje verhuist de zee’ van de dinsdag overleden schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper

en.title: Golden Griffel awarded to Maantje verhuist de zee by writer Sjoerd Kuyper, who died Tuesday
en.summary: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper, who died Tuesday, received the Golden Griffel award for his book Maantje verhuist de zee.

stories.title: Sjoerd Kuyper wint postuum de Gouden Griffel, Karst-Janneke Rogaar wint het Gouden Penseel

en.title: Sjoerd Kuyper wins Golden Griffel posthumously, Karst-Janneke Rogaar wins Golden Pen
en.summary: The children's book Maantje verhuist de zee by recently deceased author Sjoerd Kuyper won the Golden Griffel award. Illustrator Karst-Janneke Rogaar won the Golden Pen for her picture book Lucy en Donker.

stories.title: Geweerde journalisten mogen uren na weigering toch weer Witte Huis in

en.title: Barred journalists allowed back into White House hours after denial
en.summary: Journalists from Politico, CNN and MS NOW were initially prevented from entering the White House on Thursday morning despite a court ruling against denying them access, but were permitted entry later that afternoon.

stories.title: Vleierij over en weer bij bezoek van Xi aan Trump in Witte Huis

en.title: Mutual flattery as Xi visits Trump at White House
en.summary: Chinese President Xi was received by President Trump at the White House, where both leaders exchanged compliments while outlining key political topics for discussion during the state visit.

stories.title: Nederland gaat tóch naar het Songfestival, maar hoe precies weet niemand

en.title: Netherlands will compete at Eurovision after all, but details remain unclear
en.summary: The Dutch public broadcaster NPO confirmed the Netherlands will send a Dutch artist to Eurovision in 2027 in Bulgaria. Questions remain about how the candidate selection process will be conducted.
